_comment: Named scopes for `fw svc osm-admin-regen --set NAME`. Each entry is submitted as one BuildAdminSetWorkflow, in the order listed. Override the file with FW_OSM_REGEN_SETS_FILE.
_chain_comment: ORDER MATTERS AND IS A CORRECTNESS ISSUE, not a preference. BuildAdminSet downloads its source FROM THE BUCKET, so regenerating children from a stale parent produces extracts with a fresh mtime over month-old data - which reads as current to anything that measures age (these sub-regions carry no replication timestamp, so mtime is the only signal). Always refresh a tier before the tier below it.

na-states.description: 96 US states + Canadian provinces + Mexican states, from the 21 GB north-america continent extract

us-counties.description: 3,167 US counties, one submission per state (51). Mirrors the europe/germany@6 Kreise run that completed in 5.2h.

eu-countries.description: European countries from the 40 GB europe extract (completed in 9.8h on 2026-08-27)
